_notes: Copy this file to run-datapatch.json. The CDB is resolved from OCI facts
through the same ownership tags as every other operation.
This operation exists because OCI exposes RunDataPatch in its API and CLI,
but oracle.oci 5.5.0 has no module for it. See docs/day2-operations.md.
Leave exacs_datapatch_pluggable_database_keys empty to run datapatch on the
CDB only. List PDB resource keys to include them, in the order they should
